bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Toy Fox Terrier social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Toy Fox Terrier exposure.
Weight range 3.5-7 lb (1.6-3.2 kg) and grooming needs (Short coat.) belong in the same Toy Fox Terrier household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your Toy Fox Terrier is also monitored for dental disease, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Toy Fox Terrier appointments.
After the Toy Fox Terrier puppy/kitten series, keep adult DA2PP / DHPP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone Toy Fox Terrier shots when the puppy seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or patellar luxation worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week Toy Fox Terrier make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave Toy Fox Terrier antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed Toy Fox Terrier dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this toy dog.
Reset the Toy Fox Terrier reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the Toy Fox Terrier core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Toy Fox Terrier misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Toy Fox Terrier health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Toy Fox Terrier adult health guide for breed predispositions such as patellar luxation, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
